verdict.rationale: ADK is an open-source Python framework (google/adk-python) that runs locally via `adk run`, and docs explicitly describe deployment options for running 'offline or disconnected' with no dependency on Google Cloud, alongside optional managed hosting (Cloud Run/Agent Runtime) for those who want it. This confirms the core product can be fully self-hosted rather than requiring a vendor-hosted SaaS. Missing for 10: a dedicated 'self-hosting guide' doc and independent hands-on confirmation of a fully offline deployment.
